newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss regional banks post higher H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: Swiss regional banks post higher H1 profits.

text.p: Switzerland's regional banks experienced double digit growth during the 1996 first half in both profits and interest income, RBA Holding, the regional bank association said.

Gross profits at the 97 regional bank members of the RBA Holding umbrella organisation rose by 16.5 percent to 230.5 million Swiss francs and interest income during the period was up by 13.5 percent to 353.0 million, RBA said in a statement.
Commission and service income rose by 18.2 percent to 46.4 million. Trading profits were down 6.8 percent to 18.4 million, the group also said.
It said total assets for the banks, at 46.1 billion Swiss francs, was one percent higher at June 30 as compared to December 31, 1995.
RBA Holding was formed by the banks in 1994 to coordinate regional bank trading and logistic operations.
